chapter_title_en: The Rage of an Old Fiendgod
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era 282: A Celestial Immortal’s Wrath & The Hunt for Ji Ning Begins
chapter_meta_description: Ancestor Xuanji, a Celestial Immortal, uses Time Rewind to uncover the killer of his beloved grand-disciple. The hunt for Ji Ning officially begins.
og_title: Desolate Era: An Old Fiendgod Awakens
og_description: A grieving Celestial Immortal rewinds time to witness the death of his heir. He knows Ji Ning did it. And he’s coming.
twitter_title: The Hunt Begins! A Celestial Immortal vs. Ji Ning
twitter_description: Ancestor Xuanji, a being from the Primordial Era, rewinds time to identify Ji Ning as the killer of Shao Yanong. The stakes have never been higher.

lore_anchors.definition: A soul-linked jade tablet kept in a clan’s ancestral hall. When the owner dies, the tablet shatters, providing instantaneous confirmation of death.

A powerful divine ability that allows a cultivator to replay past events in a given area. It requires a profound understanding of the Dao of Time and is typically only mastered by Celestial Immortals.
A legendary treasure from the Primordial Fiendgod Era that can devour and destroy the souls of enemies. Possessing one marks the owner as being favored by tremendous luck.

The highest level of Immortal in the Three Realms, having successfully passed the Heavenly Tribulation. A Celestial Immortal has transcended the Three Realms and the Five Elements, gaining near-immortality and dominion over fundamental cosmic laws.

A cultivator who failed the Heavenly Tribulation but survived through special means. They are powerful but face additional tribulations every period of time and have no hope of a normal immortal’s longevity or freedom.
A pocket dimension left behind by an ancient Celestial Immortal, containing five branch palaces. It was used by the Shaoyan clan as a trial location for their heir, Shao Yanong.
